paper_record.title: Electric-Field-Switchable Altermagnetism via Ligand Rotation in a d0 Metal-Organic Framework
paper_record.abstract: Altermagnetism combines vanishing net magnetization with momentum-dependent spin splitting. While altermagnetic signatures have been identified in metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), non-invasive reversible control remains challenging. Here we report a route to electric-field-switchable altermagnetism in a flexible d0-MOF, in which polar substituents couple the external field to ligand rotation. In the planar ground state, pz orbitals mediate 180-degree ligand-metal-ligand superexchange (J2), stabilizing antiferromagnetic order. Rotating ligands out of plane activates px/py orbitals, enhances 90-degree pathways (J1), and reverses J1/J2 competition. The antiferromagnetic-to-altermagnetic crossover occurs at approx. 34 degrees, with spin splitting of 84 meV at 90 degrees. The 90-degree altermagnetic state is switched on by the electric field and switched off upon field removal, as the constrained-rotation landscape decreases monotonically back toward 0 degrees, enabling barrierless relaxation to the antiferromagnetic state and reversible on/off operation. Ab initio molecular dynamics at 300 K shows thermal fluctuations alone cannot synchronize ligand rotation. Polar substituents provide the required coupling for electric-field control; for fluorinated substituents, the critical field is approx. 0.22 V/Angstrom, comparable to field-effect devices. This work establishes ligand p orbitals, rather than transition-metal d orbitals, as the origin of altermagnetic order and shows that polar substituents enable electric-field control for organic spintronics.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 通过电场驱动金属有机框架（MOF）中配体的旋转，实现反铁磁态与交错磁态（Altermagnetism）的可逆切换。
one_sentence_summary.en: Electric-field-driven ligand rotation in a d0-MOF enables reversible switching between antiferromagnetic and altermagnetic states.

problem.zh: 现有的交错磁材料多为静态设计，缺乏一种非侵入式、可逆的外部手段来动态控制其磁性状态。
problem.en: Existing altermagnetic materials are typically static, lacking a non-invasive and reversible external mechanism for dynamic control of their magnetic states.

approach.zh: 利用d0金属中心MOF的结构灵活性，通过电场诱导有机配体旋转，改变配体π轨道的取向，从而调控超交换相互作用路径。
approach.en: Leveraging the structural flexibility of a d0-metal MOF, an electric field is used to induce ligand rotation, reorienting π-orbitals to modulate superexchange pathways.

main_takeaway.zh: 配体旋转可作为一种动态自由度，通过改变轨道重叠模式实现磁基态的切换，且该过程可通过电场同步锁定。
main_takeaway.en: Ligand rotation serves as a dynamic degree of freedom to switch magnetic ground states by altering orbital overlap, with electric fields providing the necessary synchronization and locking.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究为有机自旋电子学提供了一种新的范式，利用MOF的化学可调性和结构灵活性实现低功耗、可重构的磁性开关。
why_it_matters.en: This work establishes a new paradigm for organic spintronics, utilizing MOF chemical tunability and structural flexibility for low-power, reconfigurable magnetic switching.

reason.zh: 提出了一种基于配体构象动态调控交错磁性的新机制，并验证了其电场可控性。
reason.en: It proposes a novel mechanism for dynamically controlling altermagnetism via ligand conformation and demonstrates its electric-field switchability.

likely_venue.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

reason.zh: 该论文聚焦于MOF材料的磁性设计与功能化，符合JACS在材料化学与物理交叉领域的关注点。
reason.en: The paper focuses on magnetic design and functionalization of MOFs, aligning with JACS's interest in materials chemistry and physics.
